title: Agora participation in persona meetings: workshop convening, committee reads of both classes, candidate-decision outputs

C1_consultation_meeting_routes.verification_mode: HTTP edge transport double against exact coordinator C1 contract (POST /api/consult/meetings with Idempotency-Key -> 202 {meeting_id, status}; GET /api/consult/meetings; GET /api/consult/meetings/{meeting_id}; GET /api/consult/meetings/proposals; GET /api/consult/meetings/catalogue)

C2_output_routing_interface.verification_mode: Consumer routing helpers (create_candidate_from_meeting_proposal, route_meeting_candidate_decisions, read_downstream_status) and BFF HTTP endpoints tested against unsponsored proposal dicts (kind=agora_candidate_decision, sponsor_persona_id=null) and the existing Agora candidate-decision store/validation/formal-approval lifecycle

implementation: services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/router.py: POST /bff/agora/workshops/{workshop_id}/meetings, POST /bff/agora/interactions/meetings, and POST /bff/agora/meetings validate workshop ownership, enforce deliberative meeting types (MT-1..MT-4, rejecting gate panels and non-paper environments), build eligible participant rosters via the existing Agora eligibility evaluator (evaluate_persona_eligibility) plus the trader's own private servant (_is_private_servant / _find_user_private_servant), reject another user's private servant with 403 persona_user_mismatch, enforce the M9 5-participant cap, and forward POST /api/consult/meetings with convened_by={kind: 'agora_user', id: scope.user_id} and Idempotency-Key to the consultation owner via CommitteeOwnerClient.convene_meeting.

services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/owner.py: project_panel_rounds projects single-round independent gate panels; project_meeting and project_meeting_proposal project multi-round deliberative meetings while withholding private persona/servant items (persona_private, private_user) and enforcing private-servant user visibility.

services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/client.py: CommitteeOwnerClient reads gate panels (/api/consult/requests) and deliberative meetings (/api/consult/meetings, /api/consult/meetings/{id}, /api/consult/meetings/proposals, /api/consult/meetings/catalogue) directly from the consultation owner with zero BFF meeting storage and fail-closed 503 envelopes on owner outage.

services/control-plane/bff/agora/committee/router.py: GET /bff/agora/committee/sessions lists both gate_panel and deliberative_meeting classes with rounds; GET /bff/agora/committee/meetings, /bff/agora/committee/meetings/{meeting_id}, /bff/agora/committee/proposals, and /bff/agora/committee/catalogue expose deliberative meeting details, proposals, and catalogue.

services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/candidate_decisions/router.py: POST /bff/agora/meetings/{meeting_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/candidates and POST /bff/agora/meetings/{meeting_id}/candidate-decisions verify sponsor_persona_id is null (rejecting trading-persona-sponsored proposals with 422), materialize Agora candidate decision records with provenance_type=consultation_transcript and execution_authority=none, and route them through the existing candidate-decision lifecycle (modify, accept_for_review, validations, review-readiness, formal-approvals:link). Exports route_meeting_candidate_decisions and read_downstream_status for C2 integration.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_meetings.py and services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_committee_memory_owners.py double urllib.request.urlopen at the consultation owner HTTP edge and verify service-token headers, tenant headers, Idempotency-Key forwarding, convening, refusal codes, multi-round reads, privacy redaction, and candidate-decision routing.
docs/deployment/evidence/AGORA-MEETINGS-20261115/evidence.json records exact validation commands and outcomes and contains no credentials or secrets.
